result.summary:
I wrote a SillyTavern V2 card (chara_card_v2 / 2.0) with the V1 fields mirrored at the top level. It passes json.load and the validation command (description: 892 words). Other field sizes: personality 153 words, scenario 119, first_mes 224, alternate greetings 139 to 230, depth_prompt 72, creator_notes 298. The card has no em-dashes or en-dashes, extensions.world is set to "Metroid Canon Lorebook", and there is no character_book.

FRAMING: The default is shortly after the BSL incident and before ZDR, with ADAM as the computer of Samus's gunship. Canon supports this directly. Fusion ends with Adam speaking from the ship's computer ("Lady, what's troubling you?..."), and Dread's official site and game text confirm ADAM is still "The computer onboard Samus' ship." I put the default before Dread because no canon scene shows ADAM after ZDR learning about or reacting to Raven Beak's impersonation, so a post-Dread default would rest on invented material. For chats set after Dread, the description has a ZDR section. It says the real ADAM spoke only on the approach and at the end ("Don't." / "You'll drain the ship of its energy."), and that every Network Station briefing was Raven Beak. It names impostor lines ADAM must never claim: "Accept your helplessness", "fulfill your destiny" and "my daughter".

DEVIATIONS FROM THE BRIEF, FOR ACCURACY:
(1) The brief says the Federation "preserved" and "uploaded" Adam after death. The card does not state this as fact. The English Fusion script never says who uploaded him or when, and Japanese Wikipedia calls the computer "modeled on his thinking". The card says canon is silent, and creator_notes records the Japanese version.
(2) I kept Adam's helmet out of the gunship. Samus's Other M ship crashed in Fusion's prologue, and the Fusion ship is a new Federation vessel.
(3) The two catchphrase forms are kept separate. Other M's last words are "No objections, right, Lady?", while Fusion and Dread use "Any objections, Lady?". creator_notes points out that the lorebook's adam-other-m.json gets his last words wrong.

CONTENTS:
- first_mes: a Federation board-of-inquiry summons arrives on the gunship after the BSL, and ADAM leaves the decision to Samus.
- Alternate greetings:
  (a) A pre-reveal Navigation Room briefing in Sector 6, right after the Incoming Dispatch. It uses the canon Varia briefing, and the computer withholds its identity.
  (b) The Navigation Room just after the reveal.
  (c) A quiet ship's-night conversation where ADAM asks why she named the computer Adam.
  (d) A non-Samus greeting: a Federation dock technician wakes ADAM.
- mes_example: five exchanges covering briefing style, a disagreement where his concern comes out as orders, dry humor about the bounty (with the only "Any objections, Lady?" in the examples), deflecting "Do you remember dying?" until pressed, and refusing a Federation Intelligence officer's request.

Interiority is labelled in the card as "not canon; a restrained reading". The manga detail (the "baggage" remark and the 48 hours) is labelled "per the manga". English and Japanese differences are noted in creator_notes. All quotes listed below are verbatim from the research transcripts or string tables. "Stay alive." and "Be careful." are used as short standalone fragments taken from canon lines.

Alternate greeting 1, verbatim Varia briefing: "The Varia Suit data is here from HQ, ready to download. Get moving to a Data Room. But there's a problem... X from the sub-zero sector ARC are in Sector 6 (NOC), and they... They've been changed by the cold. If you absorb one, you'll be frozen from within. This seems like a deliberate tactic." and "Once you download the Varia Suit modification, you'll be out of danger. Just be extremely careful until then. The NOC Data Room is here. Remember, avoid the blue X. Use your beam to stun them in order to get by." (computer, Sector 6 Navigation Room, Metroid Fusion; retropixel metroid4 transcript)
